string.text: {=!}Today is not your lucky day, traveler. Hand over your silver and provisions. The plague took our livelihoods and we have no pity left to give.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}Aye, what have we here? An unwashed wanderer carrying fat saddlebags! There is a heavy toll to pass through these plague lands, paid in coin or in blood.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
{=!}Halt right there. Our village starved when the fever hit, and no high lord sent grain. Now we take what we need to survive. Drop your coin.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}Stand and deliver! The old laws died with the empire. Give us your silver and bread or feed the crows![if:convo_angry]
{=!}Drop your weapons and baggage! We are desperate survivors, not beggars, and we will gut you where you stand.[if:convo_aggressive]
{=!}You! Turn out your pouches and saddlebags. Any clean bread or silver you carry belongs to us now.[if:convo_bared_teeth]
{=!}Welcome to our woods, traveler. The pestilence chased us from the towns, and these tracks belong to us now. Pay our passage toll or bleed.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}Another plump refugee stumbling into our domain. Hand over your denars before our archers take your life.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}We sailed across the water only to find your cities smoldering and sick. We will take your steel and provisions back to our ships![rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}Halt, northerner! You bring pestilence and fever to our sands. Leave your silver and your horses, or your bones will bleach beneath the sun.
{=!}A dry wind blows through the dunes, traveler. Hand over your clean water and gold, and we will spare your throat.[rf:convo_mocking_revenge]
{=!}Halt your mount! Whole clans perished in the Great Sickness; the steppe belongs only to those who take it. Hand over your saddlebags!

{=iLEhyGI8}The Calradians pride themselves on discipline, heavy armor, and master combined-arms warfare.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- INFANTRY: Imperial Legionaries form one of the toughest defensive shieldwalls in Calradia, equipped with heavy armor, broad shields, and throwing pilums. Supported by Veteran Menavliatons, lethal two-handed polearm shock troops specialized in cleaving cavalry.{newline}- RANGED: Versatile missile options. Imperial Palatine Guards provide rapid composite bow fire, while Imperial Sergeant Crossbowmen wield heavy pavise shields and armor-piercing crossbows.{newline}- CAVALRY: Elite Imperial Cataphracts represent the most heavily armored shock lance cavalry on the continent. Imperial Bucellarii provide mobile mounted archery support.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Highly adaptable combined-arms doctrine with outstanding armor, strong shields, and answers to every battlefield threat.

{=ZPaw3WuO}The feudal lords of Vlandia dominate open battlefields through crushing shock cavalry charges and heavy crossbow salvos.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- CAVALRY: Vlandian Banner Knights deliver the most devastating couched-lance heavy cavalry charge in Calradia, supported by agile Vanguard lancers. (Note: No horse archers).{newline}- RANGED: Vlandian Sharpshooters wield high-damage heavy crossbows and pavise shields. Exceptional in defensive sieges and lethal at medium range, with formidable melee stats.{newline}- INFANTRY: Vlandian Sergeants hold solid spear-and-shield formations, while Voulgiers and Pikemen wield brutal two-handed polearms designed to halt enemy cavalry charges and cleave enemy frontlines.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Heavy cavalry hammer and crossbow anvil. Devastating in open plains, but lacks horse archers and requires cavalry micro.

{=c1Ag8YJS}Masters of woodland ambushes, skirmishing, and guerrilla tactics, the fiercely independent tribes of Battania rule through archery and raw melee ferocity.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- ARCHERS: Battanian Fian Champions are the undisputed kings of archery in Calradia—possessing unmatched longbow range, arrow velocity, and rate of fire. When closed upon, they draw two-handed greatswords and fight as lethal shock infantry.{newline}- INFANTRY: High-damage skirmishers and shock troops. Battanian Wildlings unleash devastating volleys of heavy throwing javelins before closing in, while Oathsworn form sturdy shieldwalls and Veteran Falxmen cleave enemy lines with hooked blades.{newline}- CAVALRY: Battanian Mounted Skirmishers provide light javelin cavalry for harassment only. (Note: No heavy shock cavalry or horse archers).{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Unrivaled missile supremacy and javelin skirmishing. Excels in forests and uneven terrain, but vulnerable to open-field cavalry charges if caught without infantry screens.

{=HD2wzAxz}Born of the frozen northern forests and coastlines, Sturgian warbands crush their adversaries with impenetrable shieldwalls and brutal close-quarters axes.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- INFANTRY: The strongest shieldwall infantry in Calradia. Sturgian Heavy Axemen carry massive round shields, lethal axes with bonus damage against shields, and throwing axes. Heavy Spearmen brace against cavalry charges, while Heroic Line Breakers swing devastating two-handed executioner axes that obliterate infantry formations.{newline}- CAVALRY: Sturgian Druzhinnik Champions are heavily armored noble cavalry with round shields and heavy lances, capable of dismounting as Tier-6 heavy shock infantry. (Note: No horse archers).{newline}- RANGED: Sturgian Veteran Bowmen provide light skirmish support; lacks crossbows and elite ranged specialists.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Grinding infantry superiority and defensive shieldwalls. Dominates chokepoints and infantry clashes, but relies on sturdy formation play to counter heavy missile fire.

{=Khr5yETv}Rulers of the southern dunes and sun-scorched oases, the Banu Asera field fast, flexible, and balanced armies adept in mobile skirmishing.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- CAVALRY: High-mobility noble warfare. Aserai Vanguard Faris are elite cavalry armed with broad shields, spears, and lethal armor-piercing Jarid throwing javelins. Supported by Mameluke Heavy Cavalry.{newline}- RANGED: Aserai Master Archers possess some of the highest bow handling and rapid-fire archery in Calradia. Mameluke Heavy Horse Archers offer mobile mounted archery.{newline}- INFANTRY: Aserai Veteran Infantry are versatile frontline fighters carrying broad shields, swords, and throwing javelins. Mameluke Palace Guards wield fearsome two-handed crescent axes that shred infantry lines.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Highly versatile combined-arms with strong skirmish throwing weapons across both infantry and noble cavalry. Excels at hit-and-run tactics and mobile field battles.

{=HkZ4E94O}Riders of the eastern steppe seas, the Khuzait Khanate overwhelms opponents with unrivaled horse archery, superior mobility, and swift encirclement.{newline}{newline}MILITARY ROSTER BREAKDOWN:{newline}- HORSE ARCHERS: The premier horse archer faction in Calradia. Khuzait Heavy Horse Archers encircle enemy lines with endless composite bow fire. The noble Khuzait Khan's Guard is the deadliest hybrid unit in the game, wielding pinpoint accurate recurve bows and lethal polearm glaives that destroy opponents in melee.{newline}- CAVALRY: Khuzait Heavy Lancers execute rapid shock flank attacks to disrupt enemy formations.{newline}- INFANTRY: Khuzait Darkhans form sturdy spear-and-shield formations to protect backlines and hold chokepoints. Supported by Khuzait Marksmen bowmen.{newline}- TACTICAL PROFILE: Total cavalry and horse-archer dominance. Unbeatable in wide open plains through continuous skirmishing, though requires discipline in tight mountainous terrain and sieges.
